description: Detect a web page's language: html lang attribute, Content-Language header, og:locale, hreflang alternates (other language versions) and a guess from the visible text. Fast (1-3 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.

name: language
title: Detect a web page's language
